CHONGQING · GUIYANG · CHENGDU

A wedding in Chongqing, cherry blossom in Guizhou, pandas in Chengdu.

Eleven nights from Singapore, built around Saturday's wedding in Chongqing. Then two shots at the Pingba cherry blossom, and a soft landing in Chengdu.

Day by day

Thu 18 MarTravelArrival
Evening flight out of Singapore, landing Friday 01:15.
  • SQ 818 departs SIN 20:20, lands Chongqing 01:15 Friday. 4h55.
  • Book the hotel from tonight: you check in around 02:30 in the small hours.
  • CKG is 30 to 40 minutes from the centre. Pre-book a car or use Didi.
  • No metro at that hour.
Fri 19 MarScenicNightlife
Recovery day: the vertical city, gently.
  • Start late after the 01:15 landing. Keep to short metro hops.
  • Liziba: ride Line 2 through the block of flats. Kuixinglou bridge, then the Eighteen Stairs at Shibati.
  • Yangtze Cableway: short, cheap, the best value view in the city.
  • After dark: Hongya Cave. Enter from the top and walk down. Eat light.
Sat 20 MarFestival
The wedding. The whole day is family.
  • Wedding dinner tonight MUST-SEE. Nothing else is scheduled on purpose.
  • If a free morning appears, have xiaomian breakfast on a plastic stool.
  • The whole trip is built around this day.
Sun 21 MarCultureFood
Still Chongqing, still family. Keep it loose.
  • Book nothing that needs a ticket. Family lunches and visits fill the day.
  • Ciqikou Ancient Town: 30 minutes on Line 1. Go before 10:00 for mahua twists.
  • Quieter: Eling Park for the two rivers view, or the free Three Gorges Museum.
  • If it frees up: Dazu Rock Carvings, 3 hours plus travel. Last train back about 20:57. Dinner: hotpot.

Know before you go

  • Built on steep hills. A 400 m walk on the map can be six flights of stairs.
  • Roughly two hours of sun a day in March. Treat every skyline view as opportunistic.
  • Only one of four nights is yours. Sunday is left empty on purpose.

Day by day

Mon 22 MarTravelFood2h00 driving
Breakfast, then two hours south to Guiyang.
  • Chongqing to Guiyang North, about 2 hours on a G train. Frequent service.
  • Ask hotel staff and drivers about the blossom today, for tomorrow's attempt.
  • Jiaxiu Pavilion in the Nanming River, then Qianling Mountain Park. Keep your bag zipped near the macaques.
  • Evening: grilled tofu and lao guo around Erqi Road. Pack a day bag, set an alarm.
Tue 23 MarNatureScenic1h00 driving
Blossom day: Gui'an (Pingba), main attempt.
  • Be inside the gate by 07:00. About an hour from Guiyang by car.
  • Best windows 07:00 to 11:00 and after 17:00. Entry free; shuttle about ¥15 one way, ¥30 return.
  • 700,000 trees across 24,000 mu, Guinness certified the largest cherry blossom base MUST-SEE.
  • Ask staff which zone is best today. Fanying Square, Xunying Garden, Manying Garden.
Wed 24 MarNatureCulture
Reserve day: second blossom run, or Qingyan.
  • Decide over breakfast, from what you saw yesterday.
  • If Tuesday was thin or early: go back to Pingba. 24 hours can change the garden.
  • If it delivered: Qingyan Ancient Town, 29 km, about 27 minutes by car or a ¥10 bus.
  • If the weather turned: Huangla Village, smaller and sheltered. Dinner: sour soup fish.

Know before you go

  • About 1,100 m up, so evenings run colder than Chongqing or Chengdu.
  • Wettest stop, about 15 rain days in March. Bring a real shell.
  • Bloom peaks mid March. Tuesday is late for the white, inside the pink.

Day by day

Thu 25 MarTravelCulture3h00 driving
Breakfast, then three hours north to Chengdu.
  • Guiyang North to Chengdu East, about 3 hours on a G train. 84 pairs a day.
  • Arrive early afternoon and drop bags.
  • People's Park and the Heming teahouse: bamboo chairs, refillable tea.
  • Evening: Jinli or Taikoo Li, or a Chengdu hotpot, milder than Chongqing's.
Fri 26 MarScenicTravel
Leshan Giant Buddha, on your only weekday.
  • Train Chengdu to Leshan, about 1 hour, ¥41 to ¥55 second class, then bus or taxi.
  • The 71 metre Buddha MUST-SEE needs 2 to 3 hours. Queue for the cliff stairway first.
  • The boat shows the whole Buddha head on in about 30 minutes. Do it as well.
  • Back in Chengdu for dinner. About 8 hours door to door.
Sat 27 MarNatureCulture
Pandas at opening, then bronze masks.
  • Panda Base gate at opening, about 07:30 MUST-SEE. Pandas feed and move 08:00 to 10:00.
  • Afternoon: Sanxingdui Museum, Guanghan. 18 minutes by rail from Chengdu North, about ¥8, entry about ¥72.
  • Book Sanxingdui online ahead BOOK AHEAD. Saturday slots sell out.
  • Ask the hotel what cherry blossom is out in city parks.
Sun 28 MarNatureCulture
Mountain or a slow city day. Your last one.
  • Choose by how tired you are. Three days out of the city is a lot.
  • With legs: Mount Qingcheng and Dujiangyan, 30 to 40 minutes by train from Chengdu Xibu.
  • Without: Wuhou Shrine, Jinli, Jinsha Site Museum, a teahouse afternoon.
  • Evening: Sichuan opera at Shufeng Yayun. Book a day ahead. Pack tonight.
Mon 29 MarTravel
Early start, home by mid afternoon.
  • SQ 847 departs Chengdu Tianfu 10:00, lands Singapore 15:10. 5h10.
  • TFU is about 50 km out. Be there by 08:00, so leave around 07:00.
  • Arrange the car the night before. Do not gamble on a morning Didi.
  • Not a sightseeing day. The trade is landing home with the evening yours.

Know before you go

  • Friday is the only weekday here, so it goes to Leshan.
  • Sunday is optional. A teahouse day is a good use of it.
  • The softest of the three cities: flat, good metro, slow.
